subject: CPickup collectible system — pool layout, type enum, and respawn logic
overview: Pickups are world-space collectible entities: weapons, health, armour, money, mission items, and script-placed objects. The game maintains a fixed pool of 320 CPickup slots. Each slot cycles through three states: VISIBLE → COLLECTED → RESPAWNING → VISIBLE. Pickup triggers are spherical proximity tests, not collision volumes.

fields.name: m_nModelIndex
fields.description: Model ID of the rendered pickup mesh (0 = no mesh)

fields.name: m_nAmmo
fields.description: Ammo count for weapon pickups; money amount for cash pickups

fields.name: m_nRespawnTime
fields.description: Game ticks until respawn (set when collected; 0 = ready)

fields.name: m_pObject
fields.description: Pointer to the world CObject that renders the pickup mesh; null when not visible

fields.name: m_nIndex
fields.description: Slot index in the pool; used to reconstruct handle from collected callback

fields.name: m_nMoneyPerVisit
fields.description: Money awarded per collection cycle (revenue pickups only)

fields.name: m_nMessage
fields.description: GXT key hash for the on-screen message shown when collected (0 = no message)

PICKUP_IN_SHOP.description: For-sale in Ammu-Nation (not used in world)

PICKUP_ON_STREET.description: Respawning street pickup (weapons left by dead peds)

PICKUP_ONCE.description: Single-collect; disappears after pickup (hidden packages, collectibles)

PICKUP_ONCE_TIMEOUT.description: Once, with a 20-second timeout before auto-remove

PICKUP_COLLECTABLE1.description: Oyster / horseshoe / snapshot collectible (tracked in stats)

PICKUP_MINE_ARMED.description: Active mine — triggers explosion on proximity

PICKUP_FLOATINGPACKAGE.description: Package that floats on water (drug deal drops)

PICKUP_ON_STREET_SLOW.description: Respawning street pickup with 30s respawn instead of 10s

rotation_animation.description: Visible pickups rotate around the Z axis. The rotation is applied to the CObject's matrix every frame at a fixed angular velocity.

CPickups_Update.description: Per-frame update: advance respawn timers, spawn/remove CObject, test proximity

CPickups_GivePlayerGoodiesWithPickUpMI.description: Called when player collects a pickup — applies weapon/health/ammo/money to player

CPickups_AddPickUp.description: Spawn a new pickup at a world position; returns slot index
